<thought>From the 13C NMR data, only one signal falls in the typical methyl carbon region (≈10‑30 ppm): a peak at 26.40 ppm. The other upfield signals (36.40 ppm) are higher than usual for methyl carbons and likely correspond to methylene or tertiary carbons. Therefore the molecule contains a single methyl (CH₃) group.</thought>
